text: The purpose of this report is to inform General Government Committee of the guidelines and principles used for achieving "City Building Objectives" when City real estate is recommended for sale or long-term lease, or for transfer to CreateTO to develop for a market offering or a joint venture. Specifically, this information report addresses: 1. The approved direction(s) informing real estate decisions (i.e., Council direction on City priorities, policy objectives, City Planning frameworks, etc). 2. The “City Building” guidelines and principles applied when City lands are considered for potential transfer or sale (e.g., Council directed program outcomes). 3. The process, due diligence activities, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration that is undertaken before a Council recommendation for a land transfer or sale is made.
